rubric: Tark benchmark rubric, 12 points: strategy match 3 (gate below 2), risk/liquidity match 3, provider independence 2 (an affiliated provider is ineligible), data held 2, pricing basis match 2, threshold 7/12

reasons: strategy_match 3/3: a private-market index of private equity for a evergreen private equity fund

risk_liquidity_match 2/3: appraisal-based index without a dealing mechanism of its own against a NAV fund (quarterly dealing at NAV under 5% cap per quarter): the pricing process matches, the liquidity terms cannot
provider_independence 2/2: provider unaffiliated with the fund (Cambridge Associates): the registry affiliation map ties it to none of the fund's advisers
data_held 0/2: licensed series not held (no subscription): the candidate is cited, not computed
pricing_basis_match 2/2: both appraisal-based NAV series
selected.comparison_note: cited, series not in the record: no comparison computed

slot_g.label: Peer comparison (paragraphs (g) and (h))
slot_g.survivorship_note: The cohort is the roster's 5 surviving, still-filing products. Funds that closed, merged, or stopped filing are not in it, so any composite carries survivorship bias in the fund's favor. Membership rationales and exclusions are in the roster record.
slot_g.heterogeneity_note: Members span 2 wrapper types (non-traded LLC ('34 Act), tender-offer fund) and 2 leverage regimes (1940-Act asset-coverage limits, no 1940-Act leverage limits (34-Act conglomerate)). Fee bases, leverage and exit rights are not like-for-like, so the comparison is a history of similar investments, not a like-for-like index.

composite.weighting: equal-weight across peers, only over periods every peer reports
composite.statistic: relative wealth ratio vs peer composite
composite.not_pme_note: Not a public market equivalent: the peer composite is appraisal-based, constructed by the evaluator and cannot be bought.
composite.reason: members report on different year ends and no member has a series that builds a common calendar period (StepStone Private Markets fiscal years to month 03, KKR Private Equity Conglomerate LLC calendar years, Ares Private Markets Fund fiscal years to month 03, AMG Pantheon Fund, LLC fiscal years to month 03, Hamilton Lane Private Assets Fund fiscal years to month 03). A composite needs identical start and end dates for every member
composite.candidate: Peer composite, evergreen private equity cohort without Hamilton Lane Private Assets Fund
